an6.74:1.1: LXXIV. Cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ. Katame cha? Kāmavitakkaṃ, vyāpādavitakkaṃ, vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ, kāmasaññaṃ, vyāpādasaññaṃ, vihiṃsāsaññaṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.
an6.74:2.1: Cha bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ. Katame cha? Kāmavitakkaṃ, vyāpādavitakkaṃ, vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ, kāmasaññaṃ, vyāpādasaññaṃ, vihiṃsāsaññaṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharitun ti. Devatāvaggo sattamo.
an6.74:3.0: Tass' uddānaṃ: Anāgāmi arahaṃ ca mittā devatā so vata Sakkhi balataṃ jhānaṃ ca apare duve pi
